title: Gaming
tagline: GTA VI's launch, the reviews and what everyone's playing, through to The Game Awards.
subject: Pop culture

briefing.headline: GTA 6 is out and is the biggest PlayStation launch so far, with a first patch now live on PS5 and Xbox.

points.text: GTA 6 had a record first week. IGN reports more than 30 million PlayStation sales, making it the biggest single game launch in PlayStation's history.
points.label: reported

points.text: The first patch (01.002.002) is live on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It fixes several bugs, including a weather system issue.
points.label: reported

points.text: A game-breaking bug is stopping some players from moving the story forward. Polygon reports this, and some players see issues on a small number of Xbox and PS5 consoles.
points.label: reported

points.text: The Witcher 4 will launch on Xbox on day one, CDPR says, even though it signed a marketing deal with Sony.
points.label: reported

points.text: Rockstar says it stopped players replaying missions to give the story and quests more freedom.
points.label: reported
